VERSION 3.28.0.172
; A quote under the date on qMarkable Home, set in EB Garamond italic
; (ships with the firmware). Edit the text below to change it.
;
; Requires: qmarkableHome.qmd, xovi + qt-resource-rebuilder. Firmware 3.28.0.172.

SLOT qmHomeHeader
    INSERT {
        Text {
            id: qmQuote
            topPadding: 14
            text: "per aspera ad astra"
            font.family: "EB Garamond"
            font.italic: true
            font.pixelSize: 40
            color: "#333333"
        }
    }
END SLOT
